info.title: iLOTBET API
info.description:
A live, auto-generated OpenAPI for iLOTBET (ilotbet.com).
The paths mirror iLOTBET's own frontend API (`/api` on https://www.ilotbet.com). Call these paths on this server and it forwards them to iLOTBET with the RSA-MD5 signature the site requires, then returns the site's JSON unchanged.
Schemas are inferred from live responses at generation time, so they follow the site. Regenerate with `npm run generate:ilotbet` to pick up new endpoints and fields.
No account token is configured (ILOTBET_TOKEN): account endpoints will return 401.
NOTE: iLOTBET refused this generator's network (234/247 probes answered 403), so the schemas below are empty. This is the site's IP geolocation, not a bug: run the generator from a region iLOTBET serves and the schemas fill in.
